title: Payments
summary: The list of all money received for your orders. Use it to check who paid, how much, and when.

sections.title: What is this page?
sections.intro: Payments is a record book. Every time money is received for one of your orders, one line is added here. The line says which order, how much, who paid, and when.

blocks.title: In simple words
items: One line is one payment. An order can have more than one line, for example when a buyer pays half now and half later.
The page shows money you received. It does not show what you owe the marketplace. That is on the System commission page.
You do not add payments on this page. You add them on the order itself (see "What you must do" below). This page is for looking and checking.

blocks.text: Think of it like your own notebook of money in. If a payment is not on this list, the website does not know about it, and the order is not marked paid.

sections.title: Why does it matter to you?

items: An order counts as a sale on your dashboard only after it is fully paid. A missing payment line means a missing sale in your reports.
Your system commission is counted when an order is fully paid. So the payment lines decide what you owe the marketplace.
Each line keeps the proof (a screenshot or photo) and the transaction number. If a buyer says "I paid" or "I did not pay", you can show the proof.
You can see at a glance which orders are still waiting for money, so you do not forget to follow up.

blocks.title: The buttons at the top (payment status)

items.means: Orders where nothing was received yet.
The buyer paid some of the total. The rest is still due.
Which order the money is for. Press "Open" to see the whole payment.
The way they paid: bKash, Nagad, bank, cash and so on.
The number on the payment slip or message. Use it to find the money in your own bKash or bank.
A red mark. This payment was cancelled after it was added, for example because it was a mistake.

blocks.title: How to
steps: Press a status button to show only that kind, for example "Not paid yet".
Or type an order number, a customer name or phone, or a Transaction ID in the boxes.
Use "Paid by" to see only bKash, only bank, and so on.
Use the amount and date boxes to look at a certain period or size.
Press "Clear all filters" to start again.

sections.title: What you must do with this list

blocks.title: A simple routine
steps: Open "Not paid yet" and "Part paid" often. These are orders still waiting for money.
When money arrives in your bKash, Nagad or bank, find the order and record the payment on it. (Orders topic, "Record a payment".)
Open the new line and check that the amount and the proof are right.
If you made a mistake, open the order and press "Reverse" on that payment. Then record it again correctly.

blocks.text: Never record a payment you have not really received. A false payment marks the order as paid, adds it to your sales, and adds system commission that you must pay.

items.q: Where do I add a new payment?
items.a: Open the order and use "Record payment" there. This page only lists payments.

items.q: Why is an order not on this list?
items.a: It may have no payment yet. Press the "Not paid yet" button to see those orders.
No. Reverse the payment and record it again with the right amount. This keeps a clear history.

items.q: What does the red "Reversed" mark mean?
items.a: That payment was cancelled. It no longer counts as money received.
